olivia (Sales): FYI — AcmeBank needs clarification on an air-gapped HSM + customer-managed-key POC. They asked for cost delta, ops support, and throughput guidance.
kevin (SolutionsEng): Can you paste their Qs? curious about max QPS and if they require on-site key ceremony.
sam (AcmeOps): they require an offline key ceremony (on-prem HSM, no internet), FIPS 140-2 L3 attestation, and ~3k sign ops/s at peak. Also want 99th pct latency <100ms for signing traffic.
olivia (Sales): Also asked whether we can provide an audited witness and a runbook template. pricing question: one-time setup vs monthly premium for BYO-HSM.
jessica (Security): For the security questionnaire we'll need: architecture diagram showing network segregation, KMS attestation docs, key usage policies, KMS audit-log retention settings, and separation-of-duties for key custodians. Also need how we handle key-escrow/escape-hatch.
kevin (SolutionsEng): Technical notes: offline ceremony means we supply a signed SOW and an ops checklist. Two paths: 1) On-site engineer to perform ceremony + HSM provisioning (adds flat setup fee + travel) or 2) customer performs ceremony with remote witness (lower cost). Either way we support a key-proxy inside their network that does envelope encryption and local caching to hit latency/SLOs.
kevin (SolutionsEng): Suggested config snippet:
```
key_proxy: true
cache_ttl_ms: 200
batching: auto
max_connections: 2500
```
kevin (SolutionsEng): With cache_ttl_ms=200 and local proxy we'll meet 100ms 99th p99 for sign ops up to ~3k/s on a small proxy fleet. Throughput scales with proxy nodes and HSM ops/sec.
sam (AcmeOps): OK — what about key rotation policy? they want quarterly rotation and immutable rotation logs for audits.
jessica (Security): We support scheduled rotation via our control plane; for offline customer keys rotation requires either new key import from ceremony or split-unwrap via HSM. We'll provide signed rotation attestations for compliance. Need to confirm log collection: if HSM is air-gapped, customer must ship audit logs or we can pull via a secure offline media transfer process (SOW item).
olivia (Sales): Pricing: recommend quoting a one-time BYO-HSM onboarding fee (engineering + ops) + monthly private deployment support premium. Also add an optional on-site ceremony day-rate and travel estimate.
kevin (SolutionsEng): I'll draft recommended sizing and SOW bullets: proxy sizing, expected HSM ops/sec, witness options, runbook steps, rollback path.
devops-bot: Template SOW: https://redwood.internal/sow-templates/byo-hsm-airgap (internal link) :link:
sam (AcmeOps): Can we get a timeline? they need cutover during their maintenance window in 6 weeks.
olivia (Sales): We'll aim to deliver draft SOW + price breakdown by EOD tomorrow. Kevin, Jess — can you add required security artifacts to the SOW and call out the on-site vs remote cost delta?
jessica (Security): On it. I'll add the artifact list and the audit-log transfer options. :white_check_mark:
kevin (SolutionsEng): Will add sizing and the proxy config with expected perf numbers. Also include fallback: use host-based envelope keys for temporary burst if HSM throttles.
sam (AcmeOps): Thx — once we have SOW we'll validate with security and schedule the maintenance window booking.
olivia (Sales): Great. tagging @kevin and @jessica for follow-up. :thumbsup:
